summary: Iteration 4: Live chat + admin chats-tab overhaul verified end-to-end. Backend 6/6 pytest passing (deposit min RAP 200, guest single-chat + 429 cooldown on close/reopen, admin listing/search, deposit preview+confirm w/ bank_ledger, bulk withdrawals done + per-item cancel, guest-deposit rejection). Frontend admin panel loads with Chats tab active by default, old Deposits/Withdrawals tabs are GONE, filters (Новые 9 / В работе / Закрытые / Все) present, search+dot+balance render, PlayerPanel with deposit preview '240.00 RAP' after 20% fee works, withdrawals card shows rows/total/'Всё выдано (2)'/per-row cancel dialog with reason chips + confirm. Site live chat widget: cat avatar toggle, glass panel with no central welcome block, chat-input/send, cooldown 'Завершить можно через 2:59'. Russian 'ПОПОЛНЕНИЕ' badge shown, no English 'TOP-UP'. Home regression: 'за 24 часа' best-drop label present, no console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing quick button for 250 RAP. Only 200/500/1000/2500 rendered. Spec says quick amounts should mirror site (200/250/500/1000/2500).

action_items: Add admin-chat-quick-250 button to PlayerPanel deposit quick-amount row so it matches site quick amounts (200/250/500/1000/2500).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~2600 lines with all admin/chat/deposit endpoints inline; consider splitting live-chat admin endpoints (deposit preview/confirm/withdrawals-done) into a dedicated router alongside the existing live_chat.py module for readability.
admin_chat_deposit re-creates a Deposit record on the fly if none is pending; consider always requiring an existing deposit-kind chat request to keep the audit trail explicit.
seed_data_creation: Temporary: 2 pending withdrawals for QA user (deleted after UI verification). Ephemeral guest chats created and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration4_livechat.py can be re-used as regression. It writes/cleans its own withdrawals prefixed ITER4_. QA user (test-session-qa-1) balance grows every time deposit test runs — expected. Only known issue: admin PlayerPanel is missing the 250 RAP quick button.
rca of the issue: PlayerPanel deposit QUICK array in /app/frontend/src/components/admin/chat/PlayerPanel.jsx omits 250; add 250 between 200 and 500 to align with AmountStep QUICK list.
